title: africa's data center boom, a weaponized chatbot in Kenya, and a student who fixed the bill-splitting problem
description: data centers are landing in Lagos, Cairo, and Nairobi faster than fiber networks can retire, and someone tried to use Claude to fake grassroots support ahead of Kenya's 2027 election. also: a Kenyan student solved the one math problem your friend group actually cares about.
author: Chris Achinga
